progress.text: Rows auto-fit oversized fonts: opening a file and whole-row/column formatting grow non-custom rows to their tallest font (#833)

Number formats: parsing a format code is linear in its length (long runs of [, , or / no longer take quadratic time), and an unclosed [ is a literal when splitting sections as well as when tokenizing (#810)
Number formats: a fraction denominator with 65,536 zeros no longer crashes; format codes are capped at 255 characters like Excel (longer codes display as General, TEXT gives #VALUE!) (#807)
Security: cell hyperlinks open only http, https and mailto, after a confirmation; other schemes (file:, smb:, UNC, custom handlers) are refused (#777, part 1)
Deleting several Ctrl-selected rows or columns removes them all in one undo step (#758)

XLSX chart sheets are kept on open and save: the sheet, its drawing and chart (with style and colours) are written back unchanged in their place among the worksheets, and left out when the sheet they plot is deleted or renamed or a worksheet took their name (#727)

CSV and tab-separated export is capped at 512 MiB: a sheet whose used range would expand to more (two cells far apart, such as A1 and XFD1048576, are 16 GiB of commas) is refused with the rows, columns and limit, before anything is allocated or written (#528)
PDF writer hardening: text width cannot overflow, all-zero dash arrays and negative or NaN stroke widths are sanitised, non-finite sizes and positions draw nothing (#812)
PDF export writes the document title and author as UTF-16BE when they are not ASCII, so viewers show accents, currency signs and non-Latin text correctly (#813)
TEXT() over a range and chart labels parse each number format code once instead of once per value (#806)
SUBTOTAL(109) over hidden rows recalculates after Row Height, AutoFit Row Height and Ungroup reveal rows (found by the command-sequence fuzz)
Page Layout view: drag the margin edges on the rulers to set the page margins (resize cursor, live preview, value tooltip, one undo step, Esc cancels) (#792)
Forecast Sheet gets Forecast Start: begin the forecast inside the history to compare it with the actuals (#785)
Ink strokes save as unfilled DrawingML paths and reopen as editable ink with their points, colour and width; icons in #551 remain a follow-up
The selection outline stays visible when extended to the last row (Ctrl+Shift+Down): its sides are cut to the viewport instead of stroking a 20-million-point rectangle (#687)
File › Print selects a system printer, copies, duplex and grayscale, submits PDF jobs through craft-print on a worker and shows spooler errors; browser printing and PDF export remain available

Command-sequence fuzzing: random command sequences checked against undo/redo, XLSX round-trip and full recalculation; fixes for the table, legacy-array, spill, AutoSum, Watch Window and sheet-copy bugs it found
Password-protected workbooks open: GridCraft asks for the password and decrypts Agile and Standard encryption (#11)
Text boxes keep their formatting: run size, bold, italic, typeface, text colour and outline, alignment, vertical anchor and "no outline" (#377)
Desktop printing opens the print PDF in the system viewer; Save As offers CSV, web page and PDF; macOS File › Properties opens File › Info (#370, #343)
Windows: DirectX 12 shaders compile with FXC, so a missing or stray dxcompiler.dll no longer stops the app at start (#339, #354)
Merged cells draw their whole outline: right and bottom edges come from the last column's and last row's cells (#376)
Shrink to fit draws too-wide text and numbers in a smaller font inside the cell or merged area (#375)
Shift+Space and Ctrl+Space select the row / column without starting an edit; Control+Space on Mac (#338)
Workbooks reopen at their saved scroll position (topLeftCell, also with frozen panes) and save the current one back (#378)
Protect Sheet passwords use Excel-compatible hashes and round-trip in XLSX sheetProtection (imported passwords verify instead of being dropped)
Review › Protect Workbook opens a dialog with an optional password (Excel-compatible hash, kept in XLSX workbookProtection); unprotecting verifies it (#345)
Formula bar, name box and dialogs fall back to the cell font: Hebrew (and any script cells can show) no longer turns into boxes there (#349)
Headers and footers: first-page and odd/even variants are read, kept, printed and edited in Page Layout view; Insert › Header & Footer edits the header in place (#344)
Legacy Excel 97-2003 .xls (BIFF8) import with formulas, number formats, merges, sizes and names (#121)
XLSX pass-through: custom XML, external links, connections, query tables, printer settings, form/ActiveX controls and OLE objects are kept on save (#330, #324)
Data › Forecast › Forecast Sheet: a new sheet with the history, FORECAST.ETS forecast, confidence bounds, statistics and a chart (#322)
Startup no longer panics on a system font egui can't parse: fonts are validated and skipped (#226)
Ctrl+drag on the fill handle swaps copying and extending a series (#264)
Odd-period bond functions ODDFPRICE, ODDFYIELD, ODDLPRICE, ODDLYIELD: Financial 55 / 55 (#275)
PERCENTOF and EUROCONVERT worksheet functions (#279)
BAHTTEXT: amounts in Thai words with Baht and Satang (#291)
TRIMRANGE: ranges and arrays without blank outer rows and columns (#296)
Selected charts, pictures and shapes can be deleted from the keyboard (#213)
Ribbon translated into German (266 labels; de, de-DE, de-AT, de-CH locale tags resolve to German)
